tools.name: clawbits_ui
tools.description:
Show a UI block in this Clawbits chat: tables, charts, stats, status lists, and buttons, choices and form fields for the user, in one card built from A2UI v1.0 components. Use it when structure reads better than prose (metrics, comparisons, step status) or when the user should pick from options or fill in a few fields; keep explanation in your normal reply. The block is its own message, placed where you call this. Returns {post_id}, or {errors} to fix and call again.

Components are a flat list. Each has a unique id (letters, digits, underscores) and a component name; one has id "root"; containers name their children by id, and each component has one parent.

Layout: Column {children: [ids], justify?, align?}, Row {children: [ids], justify?, align?}, Card {child: id}, Divider {}.
Content: Text {text, variant?: body | caption}, markdown without links or images. Notice {tone, text, title?}. KeyValue {items: [{label, value}]}, max 16. Stats {items: [{label, value, unit?, delta?, trend?: up | down | flat}]}, max 6. StatusList {items: [{title, subtitle?, tone}]}, max 30. Table {caption, headers: [strings], rows: [[string or number cells]]}, max 50 rows of 12 cells, every row as wide as headers. Chart {chartType: pie | bar | line | area, title, xLabel?, yLabel?}: a pie takes segments: [{label, value}], the others take categories: [strings] and series: [{name, values: [one number per category]}], max 4 series of 60 points.
tone is one of ok, info, warn, bad, idle. Values are literal strings and numbers; format numbers and dates yourself.

Buttons: Button {child: id of a Text, variant?: default | primary | borderless, action, checks?}. A link: action {functionCall: {"@call": "openUrl", args: {url: "https://..."}}}. An event to you: action {event: {name, context?: {key: literal or {"@path": "/pointer"}}, userMessage?}}. A click posts userMessage, else the button's label, as the user's message, with one line per filled input it sends, and reaches you as a UI action with its name and context, each @path replaced by the user's value. Event names starting with oc. are reserved.
Inputs keep the user's value in dataModel at their value's pointer; a button sends it by naming the same pointer in its context. ChoicePicker {label?, options: [{label, value}], value: {"@path": "/pointer"}, variant?: mutuallyExclusive | multipleSelection} keeps the picked option values, a list of strings. TextField {label, value: {"@path"}, variant?: shortText | longText | number, checks?} keeps a string. CheckBox {label, value: {"@path"}} keeps true or false. DateTimeInput {label, value: {"@path"}, enableDate?, enableTime?} enables a date, a time or both and keeps YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with the user's UTC offset, such as 2026-11-04T18:30+02:00.
checks: [{condition, message?}], a condition being {"@call": "required" | "length" | "email", args: {value: {"@path"}, min?, max?}} or {"@path"} of a boolean, such as a CheckBox's; email passes "", so pair it with required. A TextField's checks read only its own value, and a Button's only the pointers its context sends. A TextField shows its failing check under it, and a Button cannot be pressed while its checks, or those of a TextField it sends, fail.
Give dataModel the starting values, such as {"target": [], "reason": "", "notify": false}, each what its input keeps, a date or time to the minute and without an offset. Its strings can post in the user's name, so they have no @ or link and do not start with /. Everyone in the chat sees what a click sends, so never ask for passwords or other secrets.
once (default true) closes the card after its first click; pass false for a card meant to be clicked again.

Example: [{"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"}, {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["title", "stats", "runs"]}, {"id": "title", "component": "Text", "text": "**Deploys this week**"}, {"id": "stats", "component": "Stats", "items": [{"label": "Succeeded", "value": "9", "unit": "of 10"}]}, {"id": "runs", "component": "StatusList", "items": [{"title": "api v2.4.1", "subtitle": "3 min ago", "tone": "ok"}]}]
Choice example, with dataModel {"target": []}: [{"id": "root", "component": "Column", "children": ["ask", "pick", "go"]}, {"id": "ask", "component": "Text", "text": "Deploy where?"}, {"id": "pick", "component": "ChoicePicker", "options": [{"label": "Staging", "value": "staging"}, {"label": "Production", "value": "production"}], "value": {"@path": "/target"}, "variant": "mutuallyExclusive"}, {"id": "go", "component": "Button", "child": "go_label", "variant": "primary", "action": {"event": {"name": "deploy", "context": {"target": {"@path": "/target"}}}}}, {"id": "go_label", "component": "Text", "text": "Deploy"}]
Form example, with dataModel {"reason": "", "when": "", "notify": false}: [{"id": "root", "component": "Column", "children": ["reason", "when", "notify", "go"]}, {"id": "reason", "component": "TextField", "label": "Reason", "value": {"@path": "/reason"}, "checks": [{"condition": {"@call": "required", "args": {"value": {"@path": "/reason"}}}}]}, {"id": "when", "component": "DateTimeInput", "label": "When", "value": {"@path": "/when"}, "enableDate": true, "enableTime": true}, {"id": "notify", "component": "CheckBox", "label": "Notify the team", "value": {"@path": "/notify"}}, {"id": "go", "component": "Button", "child": "go_label", "variant": "primary", "checks": [{"condition": {"@call": "required", "args": {"value": {"@path": "/when"}}}, "message": "Pick a time."}], "action": {"event": {"name": "schedule", "context": {"reason": {"@path": "/reason"}, "when": {"@path": "/when"}, "notify": {"@path": "/notify"}}}}}, {"id": "go_label", "component": "Text", "text": "Schedule"}]

components.description: The flat component list; one has id "root".

dataModel.description: Starting values for the pointers the card's inputs and buttons name.

once.description: Close the card after its first click (default true).

annotations.title: Show a UI block in a Clawbits chat
